statement: This protocol places one exact admitted candidate output beside one exact verified human-reference synthesis. It describes correspondence and divergence without converting human judgments into truth or candidate behavior into correctness.

preregistration_and_blinding.pairing_key: exact frozen corpus item identity and content hash

directional_mapping.candidate_mapping_basis: upstream VADER typical compound thresholds, frozen without tuning
directional_mapping.mapping_non_claim: The three-way mapping is a preregistered descriptive alignment convenience. It does not make the five human categories interval-scaled, choose a human answer, or establish that the VADER thresholds are correct for this corpus.

permitted_descriptive_measures: exact candidate result status per frozen item
all four preserved VADER outputs with their declared bounds
candidate directional bucket derived only from the frozen compound thresholds
full original six-option human valence distribution including zero-count options
derived human directional counts for unfavorable, neutral, favorable, and abstention while retaining the original distribution
per-item count of human responses in the same directional bucket as the candidate with numerator and denominator preserved
per-item count of human responses in each different directional bucket with counts preserved separately
per-item human abstention count preserved outside the directional denominator
corpus-level three-by-three candidate-direction by human-direction contingency counts
candidate abstention and failure counts preserved separately
human insufficient-coverage item count preserved separately
exact included and excluded item identities with reasons
immutable candidate, protocol, corpus, synthesis, result, and response references
required_provenance: evaluation protocol identity, version, and hash
real-candidate registry identity, version, and hash
candidate identity, package version, adapter revision, and configuration hash
annotation protocol identity, version, and hash
human-reference synthesis protocol identity, version, and hash
evaluation corpus identity, version, and hash
exact item identities and content hashes

lifecycle_boundary.notes: A completed evaluation describes this candidate on this exact pilot corpus and these exact participating readers only. It does not select the candidate, resolve licensing questions, authorize product use, or establish production readiness.

non_claims: Human-reference judgments are not ground truth, and candidate correspondence with them is not correctness.
A same-direction count is descriptive correspondence, not accuracy.
A different-direction count is descriptive divergence, not proof that either the candidate or a human response is wrong.
Human abstention, candidate abstention, candidate failure, and insufficient reference coverage remain separate outcomes.
The participating annotators and repository-authored pilot corpus do not represent any population.
The VADER compound value is not confidence, probability, calibration, or an overall CTRT score.
This protocol does not rank or select a candidate and does not advance the candidate lifecycle.
This protocol does not authorize creator-facing, reader-facing, moderation, restriction, or enforcement use.
